authPromptSuffix: to get information based on regulations and a professional-verified answer if needed.
welcomeDescription: HeartWise is a conversational service developed to support self-care for patients with coronary artery disease.

chat.closedDescription: The conversation with the healthcare professional has been closed. You can continue the discussion with the chatbot.

waitingProfessional.waiting: Waiting for a healthcare professional to reply...

disclaimer: Demo / research prototype. This service is not an official healthcare service or a medical device.
chatbotHelpsDesc: You can chat about self-care topics, and the chatbot will respond based on care recommendations.
chatbotHelpsDescBold: The chatbot uses AI and errors are possible.
professionalSupportDesc: If needed, your conversation can be transferred to a healthcare professional for review.
noDiagnosesDesc: The chatbot does not make diagnoses or treatment decisions. In emergencies, call 112 (Finland).
importantInfo1: This service does not replace a doctor’s appointment
importantInfo2: For sudden or severe symptoms, contact emergency care
startTyping: Start by typing your question below
welcomeMessage: Hi, I am your heart health assistant and I want to help you with your concerns and promote your health. First, I would like to know some preliminary information.
returnLater: You can also return to complete the preliminary information later from the side panel.

If you or someone near you is in a life-threatening situation, call the emergency number 112 immediately.
